title: 第15章 武力大涨第16章 笑面县尊
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
【药材：月光熊胆】
【药理：清热解毒、平肝明目、固本培元，可配合其他药物炼制为丹，增幅药效。】
【使用效果：若精之属不足五，则精属性+1。】
周元接触到一白、一绿两个光球时，两件大熊爆落的物品瞬间消失。
打开属性面板一看，上面增加了一个物品选项，月光熊胆、大熊桩两件物品被自动收纳。
“这月光熊胆竟然能直接增加属性，哪怕有上限限制，也算珍贵奇物了。”
“没想到拾取爆落物品，竟会激活物品栏，普通的柴刀与熊尸能收入其中吗？”
周元经过一番尝试后发现，柴刀与熊尸并不能收出物品栏，但被拾取的爆落物可以自由取出回收。
有趣的是【月光熊胆】与【大熊桩】只能在物品栏点击使用，不然一个只能发挥药理，一个只能当作书籍。
他从中看到了能量利用率的不同，属性面板贵在高效稳定，人身很难追求这种极致效率。
另外【大熊桩】的功效要比【月光熊胆】更慢，但也更加全面。
【技能：大熊桩】
【功效：以意领气、以气运身，内壮体魄、神意合和。】
【使用效果：3级增加精属性1；6级增加气属性1；10级增加神属性1】
大熊桩虽是外静内动的体术，但核心却是壮体养气、以气蕴神，求得是最隐晦难明的气满神足。
周元使用这卷看似立意不低的武技后才发现，它的锻炼方式十分普通。
若无属性面板加持，大熊桩和蓝星的普通拳术差距并不大，远没有表面描述的那般神异。
“石头，你咋不动了，扭伤脚了吗？”
“没事儿，刚刚腿抽筋了，缓缓劲儿。”
周元使用技能的功夫，引起了村汉们的注意，在他们的慰问声中，周元起身前往了其他房间。

“兄弟们都出来吧，熊瞎子被我们杀了，没危险了。”
周元挨着房间敲门，换来了一声声‘好汉子’的赞叹。
几个差役闻言先是对着窗外看了一会儿，然后才跟随村汉出门统计伤亡。
等差役们与役丁们看到倒在院中的两只黑熊，还有匍匐在残破窗台下的两只大熊时，集体倒吸了一口冷气。
“小郎君，你们竟然能力搏四熊，当真是好本事。”
有血肉模糊的狰狞熊头做背景，差役们连‘桥西队正’这样的名号都不叫了，瞬间变得谦卑了不少。
役丁们没看出其中的危险性，差役们却知道，能搏杀四熊自然能搏杀他们。
现在熊尸有了，多几个伤员也不奇怪，所以必须对凶狠的桥西汉子保持尊重。
“大差，你这话可算说错了，第一只大熊扑上来的时候，我们都吓傻了，还是石头找机会戳穿了它的喉颈。
第二只我们倒是出力不少，不过最后也是石头用铁枪刺穿了它的脑壳。”
“啊，没想到小郎君竟如此勇武，之前我等多有怠慢，还请郎君多多担待。”
一群人杀熊和一个人杀熊，效果是不一样的。
一群人杀还能说是桥西汉子团结敢战，一个人杀那就是真正的勇猛好汉了。
“大差别当真，这次杀熊兄弟们下了死力，没一个后退的，都是一顶一的好汉子。
若没兄弟们卖命，我也找不到刺熊的机会，这份功劳兄弟们都有份。”
content_en:
[Medical: Moonlight Bear Bile]
[Pharmacology: Clearing away heat and detoxifying, calming the liver and improving eyesight, strengthening the root and improving the vitality. It can be combined with other drugs to refine into elixirs to increase the efficacy. 】
[Effect of use: If the essence attribute is less than five, the essence attribute +1. 】
When Zhou Yuan came into contact with two balls of light, one white and one green, the two items dropped by the big bear disappeared instantly.
Open the properties panel and see that an item option has been added to it. Two items, Moonlight Bear Bile and Big Bear Stake, are automatically stored.
"This moonlight bear bile can actually directly increase attributes. Even if there is an upper limit, it is considered a precious and rare item."
"I didn't expect that picking up dropped items would actually activate the inventory. Can ordinary hatchets and bear corpses be included in it?"
After some experiments, Zhou Yuan discovered that the hatchet and bear corpse could not be taken out of the inventory, but the picked up explosive objects could be taken out and recycled freely.
What’s interesting is that [Moonlight Bear Bile] and [Big Bear Stake] can only be used by clicking in the inventory. Otherwise, one can only be used for medicinal purposes and the other can only be used as a book.
He saw the difference in energy utilization. The attribute panel was highly efficient and stable, and it was difficult for humans to pursue this ultimate efficiency.
In addition, the effect of [Big Bear Stake] is slower than [Moonlight Bear Bile], but it is also more comprehensive.
[Skill: Big Bear Pile]
[Efficacy: Use the mind to guide the qi, use the qi to move the body, strengthen the body internally, and harmonize the mind and spirit. 】
[Use effect: Level 3 increases the essence attribute by 1; level 6 increases the air attribute by 1; level 10 increases the divine attribute by 1]
Although Da Xiong Zhuang is a physical technique that is static on the outside and active on the inside, its core is to strengthen the body and nourish the Qi, and use the Qi to accumulate the spirit, so as to achieve the most obscure and difficult-to-understand contentment of the Qi and the spirit.
After Zhou Yuan used this seemingly well-intentioned martial skill, he discovered that its training method was very ordinary.
Without the blessing of the attribute panel, there is not much difference between the ordinary boxing skills of Big Bear Zhuang and Blue Star, and they are far from as magical as described on the surface.
"Shitou, why can't you move? Did you sprain your foot?"
"It's okay, I just had a leg cramp, please take it easy."
Zhou Yuan's skill in using skills attracted the attention of the villagers. Amidst their condolences, Zhou Yuan got up and went to other rooms.
"Brothers, please come out. We have killed Blind Bear. There is no danger anymore."
Zhou Yuan knocked on the door next to the room and received compliments of 'what a good man'.
After hearing this, several officers looked out the window for a while, and then followed the villagers out to count the casualties.
When the guards and servants saw the two black bears lying in the yard and the two big bears crawling under the broken window sill, they collectively gasped.
"Xiao Langjun, you are actually able to fight four bears. You are really good at it."
With the bloody and ferocious bear head as the background, the officers no longer even called them "Qiaoxi Captain" and instantly became a lot more humble.
The guards didn't see the danger, but the guards knew that if they could kill the four bears, they could kill them.
Now that the bear corpse is there, it’s not surprising that there are a few more wounded, so we must respect the fierce Qiaoxi man.
"Dacha, what you said is wrong. When the first big bear pounced on us, we were all frightened, but the stone still found an opportunity to pierce its throat.
We did a lot of work on the second one, but in the end it was the stone that pierced its head with an iron spear. "
"Ah, I didn't expect the young man to be so brave. I have been so negligent before, so please bear with me."
Killing a bear by a group of people has different effects than killing a bear by one person.
If a group of people kills each other, it can be said that the Qiaoxi men are united and dare to fight. If one person kills, that is a real brave man.
"The big difference is serious. This time, the bear-killing brothers used all their strength. No one retreated. They were all good men who fought against each other.
If it weren't for the hard work of my brothers, I wouldn't have had the opportunity to stab the bear. All my brothers share the credit. "
